## 2. What to build

**§13 Search** (prototype frame 2)
⌘K gains **Conversations** and **Messages** (the top five, then "See all in Chat"); **Chat's Search** (the centre surface of round 5 frame 2, opened from the toolbar's Search, the bottom bar's Search and "See all in Chat", with a FilterBar: from · in · has a file · date) and the conversation's own Search use the same server search: full-text, prefix matching, Polish without diacritics ("zolw" finds "żółw", "zadan" finds "zadania"), newest first, a highlighted snippet, only what you can read; people are found through the member list, never through message text. ⌘J retires (CH63).

**Edge cases this block handles** (§Edge cases)
- Searching "zolw" → finds "żółw"; "zadan" → "zadania"; a private channel's message never appears for a non-member or an outsider; 100,000 messages → p95 ≤ 150 ms.

## 3. Acceptance criteria

**AC4 — A developer team's week**
- **AC4.4** ⌘K finds conversations and messages, in Polish, without diacritics, and "See all in Chat" opens Chat's Search with the filters
- **AC4.5** catching up after a day off is one list across conversations

**AC1 — Trust pass (v1's fourteen trust bugs, REPLAN §1.3 B)**
- **AC1.10** search finds people by name, Polish without diacritics, and says "Search isn't available" on an error, never "No messages match"

**AC12 — Platform**
- **AC12.7** search is server-side full text with `simple` + unaccent

**Tests that prove them** (file · name · AC · plain English)

- `supabase/tests/chat_search.test.sql` · "simple + unaccent, readers only" · proves AC4.4, AC1.10, AC12.7 · "zolw" finds "żółw"; prefixes match; a private message never reaches a non-member; 100,000 rows p95 ≤ 150 ms.
- `tests/chat-search.spec.ts` · "⌘K and Chat's Search" · proves AC4.4, AC4.5, AC1.10 · ⌘K shows Conversations and Messages with "See all in Chat", which opens Chat's Search with the query; its FilterBar filters by from, in, has a file, date; a search error reads "Search isn't available"; ⌘J does nothing.

## 4. Decisions that bind it

- **`chat_search(ws, query, channel?, before?, limit)`** (round-3 §2.5, #9): `SECURITY DEFINER`; `websearch_to_tsquery('simple', …)` with each word made a prefix; the GIN index first, then `chat_can_read_channel` per match (as the key's creator for an agent) until the limit (the `tasks_search` pattern, `20261011120000_tasks_sync_feed_search.sql`); **newest first**; `ts_headline` over `body_text`; **at most 50 rows**. The columns, `chat__unaccent` and the index came with CV-1. ⌘K, the conversation's Search and (CV-21) MCP all call it. People are found through the member list and `chat_people`, never through message text. The FilterBar's from, has a file and date are not in that signature: add the parameters you need and record them (my reading).
- **Polish without diacritics:** "zolw" finds "żółw"; "zadan" finds "zadania" (and "zadaniem"); a private channel's message never reaches a non-member or an outsider. Spike 5's bars: p95 ≤ 150 ms for 1–3 words at 100,000 messages; ≤ 1 ms added per insert.
- **⌘K** (`src/components/app/global-command-palette.tsx`): **Conversations** from the registry (`chat_channel` entities) and **Messages** from `chat_search`, the top five each, then "See all in Chat". **Chat's Search** is the centre surface of prototype frame 2 (opened from the toolbar's Search, the bottom bar's Search and "See all in Chat") with a FilterBar (`src/components/ui/filter-bar.tsx`, `filter-model.ts`): from · in · has a file · date; the conversation's own Search uses the same read. **⌘J retires** (CH63): nothing is bound to it.
- **Honest errors** (AC1.10, #33): a failed search reads "Search isn't available", never "No messages match". A hit or a deep link loads a window around the message with the jump bar (CV-3, CV-7a).
- Reading never needs the plan: search keeps working on a paused workspace and finds archived channels.

## 7. Watch out

- A generated-column rewrite and `unaccent` on prod are CV-1's risks (round-3 §5, 5 and 10); here the risk is leaking: `chat_search` must check `chat_can_read_channel` for every returned row.
- **Tier 2** (migrations, RLS, contracts, moduo-mcp, src/lib/runtime*): one `/code-review high` and one security scan of the diff at the end; scan findings go only into the hand-back.
- **Migration:** stamp provisional (re-cut on apply day, chat's order kept); redefine from live bodies (`pg_get_functiondef`); re-state grants by name (`DROP` + `CREATE` resets them); re-assert the Realtime publication if you publish a table; apply only on your migration turn, then `bun run db:test chat`; never `local:reset` or `migration up` (runbook, `docs/gotchas/supabase.md`).
- **Hot files:** `src/lib/runtime.chat.web.ts`. Keep edits there small; another builder may change them too.
- **Public repo:** describe no security weakness in any file; tell the orchestrator in the hand-back.

## 8. Out of scope for this block

The MCP search tool (CV-21); the Home widgets (CV-22); the retired ⌘J's old jump-to (gone with v1's screens in CV-8a).
